caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with a hinged seat that can be lifted to reveal interior storage space. The bench is rectangular and features a high backrest with a slight curve at the top. The side arms are intricately designed, curving outward and then inward in a scroll pattern. The wood has a brown color that varies in shade, with visible grain texture, suggesting oak construction. The base of the bench sits on four short, tapered legs. The composition is in three-quarter perspective, showing the front and one side of the bench, with the left armrest and seat partially lifted to display the storage feature. The drawing is rendered with fine lines and shaded with brown and reddish tones to give depth and texture. The background is left plain, and dimensions are noted below the bench.
title: Cabinet
